574:t_1:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「...So you shook off $$アークセイバー$$ somehow and rejoined us, huh?」

574:t_1:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Judging from the situation, we were caught up in a $$時空震動$$ and thrown into $$インサラウム$$... into its past, it seems.」

574:t_1:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We're not just before $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ ran out of control, we're even before $$ガイオウ$$ showed up...」

574:t_1:8.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Going by how $$アークセイバー$$ responded, it seems so.」

574:t_1:9.en:
$$赤木$$
「We didn't just jump to a parallel world, we even went back in time...」

574:t_1:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You don't have to say it, I know. The one who caused all this is me, isn't it.」

574:t_1:14.en:
$$青山$$
「You had a power that outrageous!?」

574:t_1:15.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Is it the power of the $$スフィア$$s?」

574:t_1:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Doesn't seem to be that, though.」

574:t_1:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But ever since I stopped $$レナード$$'s $$時空震動$$, I've been vaguely thinking about it.」

574:t_1:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If I were to remake the world, where would I start...」

574:t_1:19.en:
$$刹那$$
「So that is the history of $$インサラウム$$'s destruction.」

574:t_1:20.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'm surprised. So it's not about wiping out your debt.」

574:t_1:21.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'll take care of that myself. Wiping out what I've done isn't my style.」

574:t_1:22.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「It's always the same with you, but since it's about debt, it's not cool at all.」

574:t_1:23.en:
$$五飛$$
「Then your wish to prevent the destruction of $$インサラウム$$ is what transferred us here...?」

574:t_1:24.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Some eccentric god somewhere seems to have granted my irresponsible wish.」

574:t_1:25.en:
$$赤木$$
「So what do we do? Are we going to fight $$ガイオウ$$ here when the day comes?」

574:t_1:29.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's not my place to say, since I'm the one who caused it, but I still wonder whether outsiders like us, who aren't even gods, have any right to interfere with how the world is.」

574:t_1:30.en:
$n
「But even if it's a parallel world, I can't stand watching Earth be destroyed right before my eyes.」

574:t_1:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I understand how you feel, but...」

574:t_1:32.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「At the same time, we have to think of a way to get back to our own world.」

574:t_1:33.en:
$$青山$$
「$$インサラウム$$ has dimensional science. Transfer might not be impossible, but...」

574:t_1:34.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Dimensional science... You mean 《$$アンブローン$$》 Jeus...?」

574:t_1:35.en:
$$いぶき$$
「The captains are going to contact the $$インサラウム$$ royal family and ask for their cooperation, but...」

574:t_1:36.en:
$$五飛$$
「Then are they going to warn them about $$アンブローン$$'s ambition too?」

574:t_1:39.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's uncertain whether this world is even the past of the $$インサラウム$$ we know.」

574:t_1:40.en:
$$クロウ$$
「For all we know, $$アンブローン$$ here could be a kind old lady who adores her prince.」

574:t_1:41.en:
$$クロウ$$
「While we're at it, it isn't even certain that $$ガイオウ$$ will come here.」

574:t_1:42.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Exactly. Our having transferred here may already have made this a different world from that $$インサラウム$$.」

574:t_1:43.en:
$$トロワ$$
「You mean it has split off into a parallel world.」

574:t_1:44.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Then from here on, things will only go however they go.」

574:t_1:45.en:
$$カトル$$
「Even if we end up stopping $$ガイオウ$$, that will just become the new history of $$インサラウム$$.」

574:t_1:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So in the end, no matter what we do, we can't save the $$インサラウム$$ of the $$マルグリット$$ and $$ユーサー$$ we know...」

574:t_1:48.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I guess that's fine... Because we can't redo things, we can give everything to what's in front of us.」

574:t_1:49.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The power of a god is too much for the likes of us. Especially for a man like me.」

574:t_1:50.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That's right. If you had the power to wipe out your debt, in your case you'd lose your reason to live.」

574:t_1:51.en:
$$マリー$$
「A-Allelujah... Isn't that going a little too far...?」

574:t_1:52.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's all right, $$マリー$$. He's right.」

574:t_1:53.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Well... Using $$クロウ$$'s debt as the example is a bit much, but what he's saying is right.」

574:t_1:54.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Being able to return to the past is the same as losing meaning in the future.」

574:t_1:55.en:
$$刹那$$
「The past is already the past. We rejected the $$時の牢獄$$, so let's think only about moving forward.」

574:t_1:56.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I finally got to meet Big Sis, and now this happens...」

574:t_1:57.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You don't have time to be down, $$ノリコ$$. It's times like this you have to stay calm.」

574:t_1:60.en:
$$カズミ$$
「So you're $$ノノ$$. I've heard most of the story from $$ノリコ$$.」

574:t_1:61.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'm $$オオタ・カズミ$$. I'm the pilot of $$バスターマシン２号$$.」

574:t_1:62.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Another one who rides a $$バスターマシン$$... or rather, you are the $$バスターマシン$$ itself. Will you get along with me?」

574:t_1:64.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Let's work well together from now on. ...May I call you $$ノノ$$?」

574:t_1:66.en:
$$チコ$$
「What's this, $$ノノ$$...? Are you planning to swap out your Big Sis?」

574:t_1:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What are you saying, $$チコ$$! $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis is, now and for all eternity...」

574:t_1:69.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't know what happened with the Princess, but hurry up and make up with her, okay?」

574:t_1:70.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't want the Queen of Roses telling us that the $$バスターマシン$$ pilots on this side have no fighting spirit.」

574:t_1:72.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'll be expecting great things from you, $$ノノ$$.」

574:t_1:73.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's all right, Big Sis. $$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are the next best duo after you and me.」

574:t_1:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, everyone. My half-baked wish ended up dragging $c all around.」

574:t_1:76.en:
$$青山$$
「You said it. When we get back to our own world, you're buying us something.」

574:t_1:79.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Including the maintenance crew and the living-support crew?」

574:t_1:81.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I think I'll bury my bones in $$インサラウム$$...」
